title_zh: Amazing things — 第17节可背诵讲义
body_en: Amazing things are often small at first. A seed becomes a tree. A short practice becomes a skill. Ask how and why, then test your idea safely. Keep a wonder list in your notebook: three amazing facts each week. Share one fact with the class in clear English.
body_zh: 惊人的事起初往往很小。种子长成树。短暂练习变成技能。问如何与为何，再安全地验证想法。在笔记本里列惊奇清单：每周三个惊人事实。用清楚的英语和全班分享一个事实。
